note: County sells bulk parcel data via a paid request form; statewide open parcels flag is false for Kandiyohi. The county's only public parcel layers (Boundaries/MapServer/1, 911/MapServer/4, Test/MapServer/1, PublicMailingKandi) have supportsPagination=false: MapServer refuses resultOffset/resultRecordCount and the FeatureServer ignores resultOffset (same page returned twice), so the 29,766 parcels cannot be read by the paged adapter (max 1000 per unpaged query); WFS returns HTTP 400.
